project.name: Wymeswold Townscape Guide
project.boundarySource: ONS Built-up Areas (December 2024) with curated adjoining public green spaces
project.researchNotes: Townscape Guides batch audit completed 2026-08-11. Historic England and current public OpenStreetMap records were filtered point-in-polygon. The original settlement boundary is preserved in townStudyArea; 2 directly adjoining public green-space geometries were included in the active visitor boundary. Historic England official list-entry date enrichment completed 2026-08-11: 28 of 42 statutory records now carry defensible date evidence; unresolved entries were individually checked and retained as unknown.

touristAppeal.label: Not a tourist town
touristAppeal.summary: Wymeswold has recorded local interest, but its current in-boundary visitor offer does not meet the threshold for a tourist-town rating.

townGuide.headline: A practical local guide to Wymeswold
townGuide.intro: Wymeswold has a modest visitor offer within its active settlement boundary. The guide records defensible heritage and practical stops without presenting the place as a destination.

suggestedFirstVisit.title: CHURCH OF ST MARY
suggestedFirstVisit.summary: Start with CHURCH OF ST MARY and Wymeswold Village Pound, then use the planner for an in-boundary daytime stop.

townGuide.suggestedTime: As part of a wider local journey
townGuide.visitorMood: A local settlement rather than a tourist destination.
